last_frame.notes: last_frame_uri is optional and requires first frame.

first_last_frame.notes: I2V and A2V interpolate between first and last frame.

audio_to_video.notes: One input audio track drives the exact soundtrack/timeline.

native_audio.notes: T2V/I2V generate synchronized dialogue/music/ambience by default.

dialogue_lipsync.notes: Native audiovisual generation supports dialogue; exact wording still requires ASR/lipsync QC.

native_multi_shot.notes: Single generation can produce connected shots with continuity across cuts.

automatic_duration.notes: duration=null on T2V/I2V; incompatible with last_frame_uri.

generic_soft_image_reference.notes: Cloud 2.5 has first/last image conditioning, not an arbitrary multi-image identity/style reference bundle.

reference_video.notes: Cloud LTX-2.5 has no generic raw video-reference endpoint.

reference_audio.notes: Audio-to-video consumes one audio track as the actual soundtrack driver, not a soft voice/style reference.

retake.notes: LTX-2.5 model support matrix currently marks retake unsupported.

video_extend.notes: LTX-2.5 cloud model support matrix currently marks extend unsupported.

reframe.notes: LTX-2.5 cloud model support matrix currently marks reframe unsupported.

async_api.notes: v2 endpoints return jobs; production recommended.

cloud_storage_upload.notes: POST /v1/upload returns ltx:// storage_uri for generation inputs; useful for private/large SmartAIHub assets.

notes: Fast supports 720p/1080p for up to 20s at 24/25 fps; high-fps and 1440p/4K have shorter duration limits.
Audio-to-video duration is determined by input audio; max duration depends on model/resolution.
Automatic duration is available only for T2V/I2V and cannot be combined with last_frame_uri.

knownRisks: Cloud 2.5 generic product/character/place references are not first-class soft references; prebake them into a first frame or use local IC-LoRA/fallback.
An audio reference must not be mistaken for a voice embedding: A2V uses it as the real soundtrack.
Do not route LTX-2.5 cloud jobs to retake/extend/reframe even though those endpoints exist for other LTX model versions.
Exact model/resolution/FPS/duration combinations must be preflighted before paid submission.

notes: Exact allowed durations are model/resolution/FPS dependent; auto-duration is also available for T2V/I2V.
Use chronological prose and explicit natural-language transitions; do not compile a screenplay-style shot list.
LTX-2.5 cloud variants do not support the Extend endpoint in the current model matrix.
